card.name: Units right after a small number
card.fires_on: The unit or percent sign (%, mg, g) that comes straight after a single-digit number such as 1, 2, 3 or 6. It appears in dose amounts and percentages in drug labels.

modes.label: Dose unit after digit
modes.description: mg or g directly after a small whole number in a dose.
modes.example: who received a 2<< mg>> sublingual dose.

modes.label: Percent sign
modes.description: The % sign after a single digit in adverse-reaction rates.
modes.example: and in 6<<%>> of exemestane treated patients and

modes.label: Per-kg or per-mL dose
modes.description: mg after a small number, followed by /kg or /mL.
